title: Dev Opportunity Radar #25: $120K+ Atlassian Hackathon, MLH Fellowship, and INSEAD AI Founder Sprint
why_read: A weekly roundup of opportunities, fellowships, and hackathons rather than technical content.
analysis: This post curates career and community opportunities like fellowships, hackathons, and learning resources, aimed at early-career developers or job seekers. It contains no original technical material, instead acting as a links digest for events and programs. It might be useful to someone browsing for internships or hackathons, but it offers nothing in terms of engineering depth. Low relevance for a technical digest focused on substantive engineering content.
